question: What a bombing's rows and its row in a unit's panel say in a tooltip, for OpenHOI3.

addresses.name: CCombatView_WingTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __stdcall CCombatView_WingTooltip(void* entry, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element) @EAX
addresses.comment: A wing's entry in the battle window: str_bar, org_bar, else BATTLE_ATTACKMOD (+0x50), BATTLE_DEFENDMOD (+0x54), its combat modifiers (+0x40) and the entry's tactic's figures with both halves; **a row with no wing** (read whole 2026-11-14), whatever the element: a building (+0x30) FormatFixedPoint(its present level +0x24, 2) + "/" + FormatFixedPoint(its built level +0x20, 0); a good held (+0x38 not 7) the province's pool (+0x164, the CGoodsPool at +0x15C's values) by the good, 2 places; a good made (+0x38 7, +0x34 not 7) current_producing (+0x270) + "/" + max_producing (+0x294) by the good, both 2 places. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-battletooltips.md.
addresses.revises: the rows with no wing read whole: the good-held row is the pool, the good-made row current/max - the findings had the two the other way
addresses.evidence: Decompiled on a copy: entry+0x38 == 7 && +0x34 != 7 -> Format(+0x294[good], 2) and Format(+0x270[good], 2) joined by "/"; +0x38 != 7 -> Format(+0x164[good], 2).

addresses.name: CCombat_BombingSummary
addresses.comment: **What of a bombed province its first bomber's mission bombs**, the tail of a bombing's row tooltip (CCombatEntry::BuildTooltip). Read whole 2026-11-14. Nothing where the attacker has no units; with the first attacker unit's order (+0xB0): (1) every building of the database, in its order, whose slot 8 answers true, that the order's slot 30 bombs and that the province has built any of (its building's Max above 0), named by the definition's slot 6; (2) for goods 0 to 6, those the order's slot 31 takes (no province test); (3) those its slot 32 takes where the province's max_producing (+0x294) of the good is above 0. Each list, where not empty, is joined: after each name ', ' where two or more remain, ' ' + AND + ' ' where one remains, '.' after the last. out = ' ' + buildings; then ' ' + BOMB_PROD_OFF + ' ' + list (2); then ' ' + BOMB_POOL_OFF + ' ' + list (3). **Slot 31 is the stockpile test and slot 32 the production test** (the window's rows, FINDINGS-combatview.md, section 13), so the stockpiles go after BOMB_PROD_OFF 'Production of' and the production after BOMB_POOL_OFF 'Stockpiles of' - each key over the other's goods. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-battletooltips.md, section 8.
addresses.revises: read whole: the three lists' tests, the joins and which key heads which list; inferred -> confirmed
addresses.evidence: Decompiled on a copy: order vtable +0x78 (slot 30) with building slot 8 and Max > 0; +0x7C (slot 31) unconditional; +0x80 (slot 32) with province+0x294 > 0; "BOMB_PROD_OFF" assigned before the slot-31 list is appended, "BOMB_POOL_OFF" before the slot-32 list.
